mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, conditions are clear at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 65 degrees and a Waning Gibbous moon overhead.

The Verona Police Department has updated their records process to allow for easier access to crash reports, and the city is currently offering a hundred dollar rebate for homeowners who replace old toilets with high-efficiency models.
Today you can visit the Remote Area Medical clinic at Verona Area High School or check out live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, look for yoga sessions at Insight Wellness.
Regarding local safety, on July 26, a driver was arrested for operating under the influence, or O W I, after being stopped for traveling at high speeds on the highway.
Today's featured flavor is Oreo Cookie Cheesecake. Culvers is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
